_meta.purpose: Systematic anchor search across all experiments. Tests multiple candidates per experiment including physics-based, data-derived, and alternate channel decompositions.

developments.physics: PLL flip: isotropic has bowl (a>0), native has hill (a<0). Isotropic PLL is better but F17 is worse.
Nuclear valley: the best anchor is determined by which diagnostic matters most.
Diffraction systems: the transition frequency is not always the best anchor. The min-σ²_A or geometric mean may better capture the system geometry.

developments.finding: Channel decomposition matters more than anchor choice for diffraction systems
developments.physics: The number and placement of frequency bands determines the simplex geometry. Anchor refinement within a fixed decomposition has limited effect.
Fusion: the ignition point is physically meaningful but may not maximize all diagnostics.
DGLAP: isotropic works because the system spans a wide compositional range symmetrically around 1/3.
GW: the conserved system has weak PLL and F17 — the phase evolution model may need physical refinement.
